deal: Project Evergreen / 'B Wild' — PCM Hospitality Cheba Hut (Elevated Inc.) co-investment
method: Two-mode: Mode B (independent disconfirmation, lead) + Mode A (claim verification vs Cheba 2025 FDD Item 19 primary data + prior operator screen). Financial pages 40-49 + 61-62 read as images (deck hides numbers in charts/tables).

what_the_deck_covers.asset: Cheba Hut / Elevated Inc. ONLY — NOT Qdoba. This is the financials deck for the Cheba Hut acquisition leg of the PCM Hospitality co-invest.
what_the_deck_covers.operator_confirmed: David Timmons / Elevated Inc.; Kyle Archer joined 2020 as partner/CFO. p13/p14/p27 name them explicitly. p66 lists all 24 units by street address (18 CO + 6 NV), matching the prior operator screen exactly. 'Sublime Huts' cover-name from the original teaser is now dropped; the real entity is disclosed.
what_the_deck_covers.sponsor_spv: 'B Wild Investments' (the watermark on every page) = the acquiring sponsor SPV / buyer entity. 'B Wild' was the Qdoba developer in the original deck — so B Wild is the common PCM-side acquisition vehicle, used here as the buyer of the Cheba/Elevated asset. The franchisor remains Cheba Hut Franchising Inc.

what_the_deck_covers.doc_nature: Pure operating CIM. CONTAINS NO TRANSACTION STRUCTURE: no purchase price, no sources & uses, no leverage/debt, no fee/promote/carry, no IRR/MOIC, no hold period, no exit-multiple support. Confirmed by full-text scan of all 63 pages (terms 'purchase price','sources and uses','promote','management fee','carry','IRR','MOIC','pari passu','hold period' return ZERO hits).

q1_whose_auv.deck_claim: ~$2.84M avg AUV. p43 New Unit Economic Model uses $2,800 (000s) sales. p49 'AVG TTM P5 2025 P&L' = $2,838,950 sales. p65 consolidated = $68.06M / 24 units = $2,836,028/unit. p46 fact sheet sales/sqft $1,176.
q1_whose_auv.reconciliation: DECISIVE REVISION OF PRIOR DD. The ~$2.8M is NOT borrowed from the top of the system curve — it is Elevated's OWN average, corroborated three independent ways inside the deck (p49 avg P&L, p65 store-by-store sum, p64 consolidated). vs FDD: 1.44x the all-store $1.97M, 1.25x the mature $2.27M, 0.85x of top-quartile $3.35M. Elevated genuinely runs a premium book — its own stratification (p45) shows 42% of its units are >$3M (system top-quartile cutoff ~$3.05M). This is consistent with Elevated being the single largest, longest-tenured franchisee.
q1_whose_auv.finding: CONSISTENT / largely VERIFIED. The prior DD's 'AUV ~20% overstated' critique is WITHDRAWN: $2.8M is a real operator-specific number, not a system borrow. Residual: it is unaudited POS/internal data; 'TTM P5 2025' = trailing-twelve through accounting period 5 of 2025 (cash-basis, per FDD Note 2) — confirm with reviewed/audited trailing P&Ls.
q1_whose_auv.verdict: VERIFIED-consistent (operator outperformance is real and internally corroborated); AUDIT-PENDING on the underlying P&L.

q2_margin.deck_claim: Store-level (SL) EBITDA margin ~22-25%. p43 model 22.0% (after rent) / 25.0% (before rent). p45 stratification 15-22% by tier. p46 23.0%. p49 SLEBITDA $650,258 on $2,838,950 = 22.9%. p64 consolidated 21.2-24.3%. p65 store-by-store 17.0%-29.2%.
q2_margin.fdd_proxy: FDD Item 19 has NO margin table (Note 3 excludes all costs). The only profitability proxy is the prior DD's inferred ~7-10% owner-operator earnings AFTER franchise-level deductions and owner comp.
q2_margin.reconciliation: CRITICAL DEFINITION GAP. The deck's 22.9% is 'STORE-LEVEL EBITDA' (SLEBITDA) = sales minus COGS, store labor, store opex, base rent, other facility, and royalty (p49 line items). It is BEFORE: G&A/corporate overhead, management fees, owner/exec comp (Timmons + Archer), D&A, maintenance capex, and any acquisition debt service. This is a 4-wall + royalty number, NOT free cash flow to the buyer. The p49 royalty line is only 4.7% of sales (vs FDD Item 6: 5% royalty + 2% Brand Fund = 7% of Net Sales) — UNVERIFIABLE why it's light (tiered/legacy rate? understated?). True buyer cash flow margin will be materially below 22.9% once corporate G&A and owner-replacement comp are loaded.
q2_margin.finding: The 22.9% is a real, internally-consistent STORE-LEVEL number — but it is NOT the EBITDA the equity earns. Demand the bridge: SLEBITDA -> EBITDA -> levered FCFE (G&A, owner comp normalization, mgmt fee, maintenance capex, debt service).
q2_margin.verdict: VERIFIED as store-level; UNVERIFIABLE as enterprise/buyer cash flow. Royalty rate (4.7% vs 6%) flagged.

q3_entry_basis.deck_claim: 4.7x appears NOWHERE as an explicit purchase multiple. The only '4.7' in the deck text are the 4.7% SSS bar (p44) and 4.7/5 Google score (p48). The 4.7x entry comes from the prior teaser/email, NOT this CIM.
q3_entry_basis.reconciliation: If 4.7x is struck on TTM P5 2025 PF SLEBITDA $14.515M (p64), implied EV ~$68.2M. On 2024 actual $13.10M -> ~$61.6M. On 2025E $16.91M -> ~$79.5M. BUT 4.7x on SLEBITDA (pre-G&A, pre-owner-comp) is a RICHER multiple than 4.7x on true EBITDA — a multiple struck on a 4-wall number flatters the entry. No purchase price, no debt, no sources/uses disclosed in this deck.
q3_entry_basis.finding: UNVERIFIABLE from this document. The entry multiple, the EBITDA base it is struck on (store-level vs true), purchase price, and leverage are ALL absent. This is the single biggest disclosure gap.
q3_entry_basis.verdict: UNVERIFIABLE — needs the transaction term sheet / sources & uses.

q4_two_entity.deck_claim: Presented as ONE consolidated 24-unit asset. p64 rolls CO+NV into single income statements; p65 lists CO and NV units in one table; p66 single unit summary. Two operating entities (CHIC CO + CHIC-Nevada) per the operator screen.
q4_two_entity.reconciliation: Deck does NOT break out CO vs NV margins, inter-entity debt, leases, or whether NV (CHIC-Nevada, standing UNVERIFIABLE per prior screen) is included on the same terms. NV units (Sahara, Durango, UNLV, Stephanie, St Rose, Craig) are visible by address in p65/p66 but their entity attribution and any inter-entity loans/management agreements are not shown.
q4_two_entity.finding: Sold as one consolidated asset. Inter-entity debt/leases/margin split NOT disclosed. Confirm both entities convey, NV LLC good standing, and there is no excluded entity or carve-out.
q4_two_entity.verdict: Consolidated presentation VERIFIED; entity-level detail UNVERIFIABLE.

q5_double_ebitda_build.deck_claim: 'Double EBITDA' growth thesis via continued unit growth (p4, p59 '39% digital / new market expansion'). New-unit model (p43): $2.8M sales, $775K build, 70% cash-on-cash, 2.4x sales/investment, 17% CAGR first 3 yrs (p46). Case studies p50: DTC (Sep-24) $3.5M/24.5%/267% CoC/$323K build; St Rose (Jul-24) $2.3M/27.4%/95%/$674K; Craig (Aug-24) $2.4M/26.8%/85%/$815K.
q5_double_ebitda_build.reconciliation: EBITDA growth is CAPEX-BOUGHT, not organic. Same-store growth is DECELERATING HARD: Elevated SSS 11.7% (2022) -> 14.3% (2023) -> 5.0% (2024) -> 1.5% YTD 2025 (p44). The 'double EBITDA' must come almost entirely from new builds. Two cherry-picks: (a) the 3 case studies are the 3 NEWEST units, and DTC's 267% CoC is an outlier driven by an abnormally low $323K net build (likely heavy TI allowance / 2nd-gen space) — not repeatable; (b) 'Avg Buildout $775K' (p43/p46) vs case-study actual net builds averaging $604K vs FDD Item 7 range $631K-$2.086M. If new units open at the FDD SYSTEM avg $1.97M instead of Elevated's $2.8M, new-unit EBITDA drops ~30% and CoC falls from 70% toward ~45-50%.
q5_double_ebitda_build.finding: Growth is capex-driven new builds, NOT same-store (SSS collapsing to 1.5%). New-unit returns rely on Elevated continuing to hit $2.8M AUVs in NEW/unproven markets (KS, KC-MO development rights) — survivorship/selection risk. Build-cost is understated vs FDD top of range.
q5_double_ebitda_build.verdict: Thesis MISLEADING-by-omission: 'double EBITDA' is a capital obligation + new-market AUV bet, not organic; SSS deceleration (the disconfirming series) is shown but not framed.

q6_return_math.deck_case: Deck shows NO MOIC/IRR/hold. Prior teaser/email: '4-6x', 'conservative 5x exit', 'long-term hold'. Unlevered: exit 5.0x x EBITDA-double / entry 4.7x = 2.13x MOIC. With the teaser's implied ~2.5x leverage, 2x EBITDA at flat exit -> ~3-4x equity IF the double is achieved.
q6_return_math.honest_base_case: Flat 4.7x exit (= entry; 'conservative 5x' is ~flat, not conservative). If EBITDA grows to 2025E $16.9M (+29% over 2024, the deck's own projection) rather than doubling: unlevered MOIC 5.0x*1.29/4.7 = 1.37x; at flat 4.7x exit 1.29x. To reach the consolidated 'double' ($13.1M->$26M) requires ~12+ new units at Elevated-quality AUVs — multi-year, capex-funded, in unproven states. Unlevered honest base ~1.3-2.0x over a long hold; mid-to-high-teens IRR ONLY if the build program executes AND exit holds at 5x.
q6_return_math.finding: 4-6x does NOT hold on this deck's own data without (a) EBITDA doubling via flawless new-market execution AND (b) leverage AND (c) multiple expansion. Honest unlevered base compresses to ~1.3-2.0x. 'Long-term hold' quietly extends the period that 4-6x was originally pinned to year 5.
q6_return_math.verdict: Deck case UNVERIFIABLE (no structure disclosed); honest base ~2x unlevered, consistent with prior DD.

STILL OPEN: the SPV fee/promote economics (management fee, carried interest, any deal-level acquisition/monitoring/disposition fee) and the operating-company cap table (whether Kyle Archer holds equity vs. a 100%-of-Timmons purchase).
q7_fees_structure_alignment.verdict: MOSTLY RESOLVED — strong alignment (90-100% PCM, pari-passu, single call) confirmed verbally; fee/promote economics + operating-co cap table remain to be papered in the LPA.
q7_fees_structure_alignment.confirmed_terms_2026_06_25: Sponsor-confirmed 2026-06-25 (verbal — to be papered in the LPA): ~90-100% of the SPV is PCM principal capital; co-investors are PARI-PASSU (same security/price/priority); the commitment is funded via a SINGLE capital call — no multi-year follow-on calls. The single call resolves the prior 'multi-year capex obligation / surprise follow-on' concern and is a favorable alignment signal.

mode_b_findings.flag: SSS deceleration is the buried disconfirming series
mode_b_findings.detail: p44 shows Elevated SSS crashing 14.3% (2023) -> 5.0% (2024) -> 1.5% YTD 2025. The slide is TITLED 'Sales Consistently Outperforming' and anchors on relative outperformance vs Blackbox, masking that absolute same-store growth has nearly flatlined. The entire 'double EBITDA' thesis therefore depends on NEW units, not the existing book. Classic takeaway-vs-data divergence.

mode_b_findings.flag: Store-level EBITDA marketed as if it were buyer cash flow
mode_b_findings.detail: Every margin in the deck (22.9%, p49) is 4-wall+royalty SLEBITDA, before G&A, owner/exec comp (Timmons+Archer), maintenance capex, D&A, and debt service. The number an LP's equity actually earns is materially lower and is never shown. The masking channel = scope-of-EBITDA (store-level labeled 'EBITDA').

p50's 3 case studies are the 3 NEWEST units; DTC's headline 267% cash-on-cash is manufactured by an abnormally low $323K net buildout (vs $775K deck avg and $674-815K for the other two) — almost certainly a heavy landlord TI allowance / 2nd-gen space, not a repeatable build economic. Presenting it as a 'new restaurant return' template overstates go-forward new-unit returns.

Deck 'Avg Buildout $775K' (p43/p46); FDD Item 7 range $631K-$2.086M/unit. New markets (larger end-cap, union/coastal labor) skew to the high end. Underwriting the build program at $775K understates the capex obligation and overstates new-unit CoC.

verdict.rating: CONDITIONAL — operations now substantially VERIFIED and stronger than the prior DD assumed; the DEAL economics remain UNVERIFIABLE because this CIM contains no transaction structure.
verdict.one_line: This financials CIM upgrades the OPERATING case (real Elevated outperformance, honest store distribution, named asset, disclosed RE) but leaves the INVESTMENT case unverifiable: no price, no leverage, no fees/carry, no MOIC/IRR/hold — and the marketed 22.9% 'EBITDA' is store-level, not buyer cash flow, while the 'double EBITDA' thesis rests on new-market builds as same-store growth has collapsed to 1.5%.
verdict.honesty_grade: MIXED. The deck itself is comparatively HONEST on the operating data (it shows the SSS deceleration, the full store-by-store P&L, the FDD-consistent stratification, and the related-party RE). The divergence is takeaway-vs-data: store-level labeled 'EBITDA', a decelerating SSS slide titled 'consistently outperforming', and a cherry-picked outlier CoC. Not a liar's deck; a polished-but-real deck whose buyer-economics are simply absent.
verdict.investable: Not yet. Operating diligence largely clears; the gate is now entirely the missing transaction terms (price/leverage/fees/promote/RE pricing/capital calls) and an audited bridge from store-level EBITDA to buyer FCFE. UPDATE 2026-06-25: structure/alignment largely RESOLVED (90-100% PCM principal, pari-passu, single capital call confirmed) — the remaining gate is PRICE + EARNINGS QUALITY (purchase price, EBITDA base, fee/promote), not structure.
verdict.location_note: Per-address operating status, unit-level ratings, and owned-parcel ownership are now PRIMARY-VERIFIED (2026-06-25). Operating case further strengthened; investment case still gated on transaction terms.

sharpened_questions_for_pcm: TRANSACTION TERMS (the whole gap): purchase price, the exact EBITDA the 4.7x is struck on (store-level SLEBITDA vs true EBITDA net of G&A/owner comp), sources & uses, and senior debt/leverage at close. This CIM discloses NONE of it.

EBITDA BRIDGE: reviewed/audited trailing P&L bridging p49/p64 SLEBITDA -> EBITDA (load corporate G&A, normalize Timmons+Archer owner comp, mgmt fee) -> levered FCFE (maintenance capex + debt service). What does the equity actually earn vs the marketed 22.9%?

FRANCHISE FEES (royalty corrected): FDD Item 6 = 5% royalty + 2% Brand Fund = 7% of Net Sales (Brand Fund can rise to 4.2%). The deck shows ONE 4.7% 'royalty' line — confirm whether it includes the 2% Brand Fund; if not, store-level margin is overstated ~2 pts (~$1.4M). [Earlier '~6% standard' was unsourced and WRONG.]
RELATED-PARTY REAL ESTATE (p66): price/cap rate for the Cap Hill + UNC fee-simple parcels owned by Timmons, or the rent under the 10-year lease alternative — confirm arm's-length.

NEW-BUILD PROGRAM: build schedule, per-unit capex (deck $775K vs FDD $631K-$2.086M), ramp, and the underwritten AUV for NEW markets (KS/KC-MO) — model it at FDD system $1.97M not Elevated's $2.8M. Is the $323K DTC build (267% CoC) representative or a one-off TI windfall?
CAPITAL CALLS — RESOLVED (2026-06-25): single capital call, no multi-year follow-on calls (sponsor-confirmed; to be papered in the LPA).

FEES/CARRY/PARI-PASSU — PARTIALLY RESOLVED (2026-06-25): ~90-100% PCM principal capital + pari-passu CONFIRMED (verbal, to be papered). STILL OPEN: management fee, carried interest, and any deal-level acquisition/monitoring/disposition fee at the SPV level.

ENTITY CONVEYANCE: do BOTH CHIC (CO) and CHIC-Nevada convey on the same terms; NV LLC good standing (UNVERIFIABLE in operator screen); any inter-entity loans/leases/management agreements; and is Kyle Archer an equity holder (is PCM buying 100% of Timmons or a Timmons+Archer cap table)?
EXIT: support for a 5x exit on a sub-80-unit single-region cannabis-branded niche concept when entry is 4.7x; model equity at a FLAT 4.7x exit (the honest base ~1.3-2.0x unlevered).
DATA BASIS: confirm whether p64/p65 'Pro Forma TTM P5 2025' annualizes 2024 partial-year openings upward, and provide the un-pro-forma trailing-actual EBITDA.
